profile.title: Full stack Engineer
summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience delivering scalable, accessible, and 
production-ready applications across financial services, healthcare, and enterprise environments. Strong 
expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3/4, REST APIs, microservices, 
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and automated testing.

Proven experience owning end-to-end workflows across reusable frontend features, backend services, event
driven integrations, and containerized delivery. Production-minded mentor who balances performance, 
reliability, and maintainability; contributes across Agile planning, development, CI/CD, and support; and uses 
AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and code quality.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology

experience.summary: Full stack engineer working on enterprise Angular web and hybrid mobile applications in a highly regulated financial environment.
highlights: Lead frontend delivery across enterprise Angular web and Ionic hybrid applications, building reusable features and resolving WCAG 2.1 AA issues 30% ahead of projected timelines.
Develop reusable Angular and Ionic features within Fidelity's enterprise design system, integrating them with Java 21 and Spring Boot REST services for secure end-to-end business workflows.

Build and enhance Java 21/Spring Boot 4 microservices and REST APIs using Gradle, Swagger/OpenAPI, Apache Camel, and PostgreSQL, owning validation, business logic, persistence, and downstream integrations.
Integrate Spring Boot services with Apache Kafka to publish and consume business events, supporting asynchronous processing and reliable data flow across enterprise systems.
Deliver full-stack reporting workflows by embedding interactive Power BI experiences and implementing backend capabilities for saving configurations, processing business rules, and exporting outputs.
Develop JUnit and Mockito tests for service and API logic; validate Kafka and REST integrations and use frontend automation and code reviews to improve release confidence.

Troubleshoot frontend, API, database, and Kafka issues using Splunk, Datadog, and AWS CloudWatch; support containerized delivery to AWS EKS through Jenkins CI/CD and participate in Agile planning and production support.

experience.summary: Frontend developer delivering secure, responsive financial applications using modern React and Vue-based stacks.
highlights: Delivered end-to-end financial workflows using React, TypeScript, Java 17, Spring Boot 3, REST APIs, and XML-based application and integration configurations.
Reduced application redesign timelines by 50% through reusable React patterns, technical leadership, mentoring, and coordination across distributed onshore and offshore teams.
Designed reusable React components and shared frontend patterns, connecting them to Spring Boot REST endpoints for consistent validation, error handling, and secure data exchange.
Built and enhanced Java 17/Spring Boot 3 service-layer and REST API capabilities, implementing business rules, validation, and XML-configured integration flows for enterprise banking use cases.

Diagnosed issues across React interfaces and backend integrations using API testing, logging, and root cause analysis; supported Docker-based builds and controlled releases through Jenkins and UrbanCode Deploy (uDeploy).
Improved frontend performance and accessibility with Lighthouse and Chrome DevTools; contributed unit testing, code reviews, Agile delivery, and mentoring across the full development lifecycle.

experience.summary: Lead frontend developer for a React Native healthcare application with supporting Node.js and Firebase services.
highlights: Served as Lead Frontend Developer for a React Native and Expo healthcare application, driving frontend architecture, implementation decisions, and reusable cross-platform component patterns.

Delivered cross-platform features using React Native and Expo, including push notifications, geolocation services, authentication workflows, and third-party integrations that improved engagement and usability.
Built and maintained Node.js APIs and Firebase Firestore document-database services supporting authentication, real-time chat, notifications, and healthcare collaboration workflows.
Improved application reliability and maintainability by expanding automated test coverage using Jest and React Testing Library.
Partnered with backend stakeholders to implement secure authentication, authorization, and data management solutions for healthcare-related user data.

experience.summary: Web application developer building responsive React and Next.js applications and full-stack solutions for multiple industries.
highlights: Developed full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, and MongoDB for clients across multiple industries.
Built reusable React components and scalable frontend patterns for e-commerce, ERP, and customer facing platforms, including a restaurant solution that increased online engagement by 30%.
Implemented centralized state management, REST API integrations, authentication services, MongoDB data access, and third-party integrations for scalable e-commerce and ERP solutions.
Collaborated directly with clients to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions and successful project outcomes.
Mentored interns and junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, technical guidance, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

experience.summary: Junior Professor and Teaching Assistant focused on web development, software engineering, and academic project supervision.
highlights: Delivered instruction in web development, programming fundamentals, software engineering, databases, APIs, and application architecture.
Supervised academic and independent web and mobile projects through requirements, design, implementation, testing, and presentation.
Developed internal academic-management applications and student-tracking tools while mentoring students on coding practices and technical problem-solving.
